Station Cat uses @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7, a JavaScript port of LAME.
Copyright belongs to the LAME / lamejs contributors (including Alex Zhukov).
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
Original JavaScript port: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
ES module fork: https://github.com/gideonstele/lamejs
License: GNU LGPL version 3; see LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt in this directory.
The upstream package's notice is preserved in UPSTREAM-NOTICE.txt.

lamejs-1.2.7.js is the UNMODIFIED dist/lamejs.js from the exact npm package.
It is loaded as an independent ES module, not bundled into application code.
You may replace that file with a compatible modified version under the LGPL.
Reverse engineering for debugging modifications to this library is permitted.
No warranty is provided; see the licenses for full terms.

Corresponding source and build files: source-1.2.7.tar.gz (same directory).
Upstream commit: 1fb0ef5fa177413107e2e107d054a9b994e3f79c (npm gitHead).
Extract the archive, install its declared development dependencies and run
npm run build. The upstream build produces dist/lamejs.js via Vite.
Application integration source is available in the public repository:
https://github.com/xdgf558/caption-ai-landing-site/tree/codex/music-admin-wav-transcode/src/scripts
